proof-statement-integrity.evidence: The Lean states the SHAPE of the block's claim but proves none of it. crystal_basis_reduction derives 'chirality AND term7 AND zHabiro' from three reduction hypotheses applied to three computation hypotheses -- modus ponens three times. What is NOT there: the three reductions themselves (conditional on Brundan-Kleshchev and Lecouvey, no instance supplied), the three finite computations (Type-B folded crystal multiplicity sum, depth-6 vertex enumeration, Kazhdan-Lusztig classical-limit functor), and any crystal combinatorics at all -- Type-B folding and Demazure sub-crystals appear only as the NAMES of opaque propositions. The fourth problem (Bloch-group decomposition of the EM coupling) is carried as a class parameter so its absence from the fields is legible, and nothing here proves it cannot be reduced; the context remark's 'transverse' is scope-limited, not an exclusion.
proof-statement-integrity.notes: The previous file was, in its entirety, 'class CrystalBasisCorrespondence where reduction_holds : Prop; reduction_holds_proof : reduction_holds' plus a theorem returning the second field. reduction_holds := True, reduction_holds_proof := trivial inhabits it, so the binder assumed nothing -- the purest self-assuming projection in the arc (AGENTS.md 3b-cond item 5). It also mentioned NOTHING from the block: no crystal, no chirality, no Term 7, no z-Habiro, no fourth problem. Re-encoded by taking the block at its word: a reduction is an implication (ReducesTo problem computation := computation -> problem), the proposition is three of them over caller-supplied propositions, and the theorem derives what a reduction is for. The .md is unchanged. Bean qou-z9ws.
